br_ska_01: At first light, Chinese troops crossed into Humla, and overran the Nepal Army's border posts at Hilsa, Yari and Limi.
br_ska_02: Within hours, their columns were moving down the Karnali gorge. Towards Simikot.
br_ska_03: The garrison is dug in above Kermi, holding the valley. The road is cut. They are running out of food, ammunition and medicine.
br_ska_04: Kathmandu has asked New Delhi for help. There is no road in.
br_ska_05: So we go in by air. One C-17, up the Karnali from the south-east, under the ridgelines.
br_ska_06: The drop zone is the runway at Simikot. Six hundred and fifty metres, on a shelf, three thousand metres up.
br_ska_07: Sixteen tonnes, at a hundred and eighty knots. One pass. Then climb out of that valley.
